businesses.business: Surplus asset sales and auction marketplaces

offering_description.value: Liquidity Services helps businesses, retailers and government agencies sell surplus assets through specialized marketplaces and hands-on sales support. It also provides auction marketplace services for auction houses and bidders in collectibles, fine art and antiques.

quotes.quote: Unlike single‑channel auction companies, Liquidity Services operates a multi‑marketplace platform combined with consultative services, technology, and compliance expertise. This allows us to route assets to the right buyers, support complex programs, and deliver better outcomes for enterprise, government, and retail sellers.
Acquisition Expands Global Footprint in Collectibles, Fine Art, and Antiques with Additional Scale, Services and Innovation for Auction Houses and Bidders.

Liquidity Services’ proprietary, award-winning, AssetZone® software, a Software-as-a-Service solution used by many Fortune 1000 organizations, allows for more effective management of the entire asset lifecycle across all of your locations worldwide.

primary_services.value: Surplus asset sale and auction management; asset valuation; buyer marketing; sales reporting; auction services for collectibles, fine art and antiques
